selected_gene_purpose: Illustrative translational candidates and reference targets; not a final receptor ranking
panel_a: Cumulative unique mouse protein-coding genes with reported human mappings
panel_b: All mouse-human relationships with assessable extracellular sequence conservation
panel_c: Canonical protein identity and bidirectional extracellular alignment coverage
panel_d: Mouse-to-human feature conservation; matched feature records divided by source records
paired_disulfide_definition: Two-endpoint intrachain or unspecified annotations; excludes single endpoints, explicitly interchain and redox-associated annotations
missing_feature_value: Grey cell and dash indicate undefined percentage because source features are absent or unavailable
asterisk: Mouse Ly6a and Ly6c1 mapped to human LY6S with low Ensembl orthology confidence
